newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Austrian ATX ends at new high, seen consolidating.
newsitem.headline: Austrian ATX ends at new high, seen consolidating.

text.p: 1315 GMT - Austrian shares rallied to end on a record high up 1.93 percent at 1,365.75, but off a record intraday high of 1,374.99 after profit-taking set in, traders said.
Next target seen 1,400 after consolidation in short term.
* ATX up 24.88 points or 1.86 pct at 1,364.75.
* Top gainer AMS, up 6.11 pct at 1,112 ATS
* Leading loser Wolford, down 2.76 pct at 1,235 ATS
* July ATX futures down 23.5 pts at 1,370.5 -- Vienna newsroom, +431 53112 257
